integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from exact partwise neighbor counts. The bundled verifier independently checks the literal definition, the profile criterion, the complete cardinality enumerator, and published bipartite special cases over every complete-multipartite profile through order nine. Finite computation supports but does not replace the infinite proof.
limitations: Specific to connected complete multipartite graphs and the standard positive parameter range \(1\le k\le\Delta\). The bipartite minimum and the ordinary \(k=1\) bipartite classification are explicitly treated as prior-covered. Negative \(k\) is excluded because domination is no longer automatic. An obscure earlier family-specific formula under alternate terminology remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: All global offensive \(k\)-alliances of complete multipartite graphs
